description: This file defines the CredentialStore class which provides an abstraction layer for persisting user credentials, including methods to load, save, and clear credentials.

classes.name: CredentialStore
classes.description: A class providing an interface for credential persistence with asynchronous methods for loading, saving, and clearing credentials.

methods.name: loadCredentials
methods.description: Asynchronously loads saved credentials from storage.

methods.name: saveCredentials
methods.description: Asynchronously saves provided credentials to storage, respecting remember flags.

methods.name: clearCredentials
methods.description: Asynchronously clears stored credentials from storage.
